title: From Promises to Accountability: Comparative AI Modeling and Visualization of Electoral Commitments in Nepali Political Texts
abstract: arXiv:2610.32150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Election Commitment Mining refers to the analysis of election commitments made by electoral candidates or political parties during election campaigns. However, many elected candidates and political parties, especially in developing South Asian countries, do not fully deliver on the promises they make before elections. Even after the elections, commitments presented through election manifestos, posters, pamphlets, videos, and other campaign materials are often not systematically or transparently archived. As a result, these promises tend to fade away over time, making it difficult to hold the elected candidates accountable for their commitments. To address this persistent issue, this research aims to develop a system capable of structuring the commitments made by candidates during election periods. translated_title: 从承诺到问责：尼泊尔政治文本中选举承诺的对比性AI建模与可视化
translated_abstract: 选举承诺挖掘是指对候选人或政党在竞选期间做出的选举承诺进行分析。然而，许多当选的候选人和政党，尤其是在南亚发展中国家，并未完全兑现选举前做出的承诺。即使在选举之后，通过选举宣言、海报、传单、视频及其他竞选材料呈现的承诺，也往往没有以系统化或透明的方式存档。因此，这些承诺往往会随时间流逝而逐渐被淡忘，导致难以对当选候选人的承诺进行问责。为解决这一长期存在的问题，本研究旨在开发一个能够对候选人在选举期间所做承诺进行结构化处理的系统。在这项工作中，我们创建了首个尼泊尔政治文本的黄金标准数据集（Cohen's kappa = 0.777），并评估了机器学习、深度学习……（摘要内容到此截断）
tldr: 该研究创建了首个尼泊尔政治文本黄金标准数据集（Cohen's kappa = 0.777），并通过对比性AI建模与可视化方法对选举承诺进行结构化，以解决竞选承诺难以追踪和问责的问题。
